name: Kyambogo University Admissions
overview: Applications to Kyambogo University are submitted online through the admissions portal at https://apply.kyu.ac.ug/. The Academic Registrar invites online applications for undergraduate programmes, postgraduate diplomas, master's degrees and doctoral programmes. Admissions run under three schemes: Direct Entry (O' and A' Level), Diploma/Certificate Entry, and Graduate programmes. Full requirements, fee structure and closing dates for each scheme are published in the official application adverts on the university website at kyu.ac.ug.
admission_requirements: Admission lists are published on the same portal (https://apply.kyu.ac.ug/) and under the Admission Lists menu on the university website. For inquiries, contact the Academic Registrar's Office at arkyu@kyu.ac.ug or Tel: 0414-285037 / 287343 / 287502, Kyambogo, Kampala, Uganda.
